summary: The deepening pass read chapters 23 (Export-Import Bank), 24 (Federal Reserve), 25 (Small Business Administration), 26 (Trade) and 27 (Financial Regulatory Agencies) in full and matched every concrete recommendation against the existing records. Chapter 23 was already covered by its two records. Thirty-three new records were researched, independently reviewed and blind-scored: c24-05 to c24-07, c25-06 to c25-13, c26-08 to c26-18 and c27-06 to c27-17 (c26-19 and c27-12 were dropped in review as duplicates of c26-05 and c27-03, and those ids stay unused). Review lowered six stages from the researcher drafts and raised one. Of the 33, 2 are in effect (c25-09 completed, c27-08 implemented), 18 are underway, 3 are classed as diverged and 10 show no action found. Reverse cross-references were added on 27 existing records. The headline set is now 457 counted recommendations.
title: Fuller reading of chapters 23 to 27: 33 recommendations added
